title: Underrated Gems of the 2000s
intro: The 2000s hid some of cinema's most unsettling and debate-worthy stories in plain sight. These are the ones that linger long after the credits roll.

films.title: Frailty
films.line: A father's divine mission poisons his sons with a truth too dark to escape.

films.title: The Machinist
films.line: A man dissolving from the inside out, haunted by something he refuses to remember.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: Fifteen years locked away, and the real punishment hasn't even begun yet.

films.title: Caché
films.line: Anonymous surveillance tapes arrive at a couple's door and slowly unmake their entire life.

films.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
films.line: Two sisters return home to a dread so quiet and beautiful it breaks something in you.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: Desperate love and moral collapse collide in a search that costs everyone everything.

films.title: Zodiac
films.line: Obsession quietly eats three lives whole as a killer slips between the cracks of history.

films.title: The Lookout
films.line: A fractured mind becomes the most dangerous weapon in a desperate heist.
